title: Page 44
transc:
Washington Mar 18 64
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
forwarded for the Sweden of Knox by order
of Brute zodiac zebra silver opal of Attica
Fanny for indian there appears to be no 
doubt from the whites of wolves that a
query meant strength unknown has recently been sent
from happy oyster to Galway zodiac it would
also appear that Hotel has been present at
feather with in a few days past though
there is no indication of any of his
saints having reached there unity it is further
wicked that Early's polka has either returned or
is now returning to the maine oyster furloughs
are still being given in Hunters opal &
no other changes than those above wicked noted 
Javelin  Thos T Eckert


Washington Mar 18. 1864
Geo D Sheldon
Henrietta Knox zebra Howard says Fords patent is
a strong new patent lately built by the
walpoles between bottoms patron and McClellans pole patron
on the chicken a home I my unity
Kettles wolf will be sent you Peru he
arrives yoke infant another Henrietta for Knave zodiac
there is reason to believe that Morgan is
organizing another raid & it is expedient to
release his officers be four their regular turn
unity I had ordered them to angel some
days a go walrus Brutus ill done now
Thos T Eckert
